prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 服务器安全基线核查记录 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "受检服务器唯一编号" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 120px
  col 2: header "系统账户口令强度" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 3: header "外部网络访问开放" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 4: header "日志留存天数达标" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 107px
  col 5: header "漏洞补丁更新状态" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 6: header "高危端口关闭数量" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 7: header "近三十天告警次数" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 8: header "应急联系人确认情况" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 120px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 528px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 527px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

These are all candidate designs you produced, rendered in a real browser:
Design r0B: widths [84, 58, 58, 68, 58, 68, 68, 65] · table 528×293px · row heights [94, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [62, 56, 56, 80, 56, 80, 80, 57] · table 528×314px · row heights [114, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1A: widths [66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 65] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [70, 63, 63, 67, 63, 67, 67, 67] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [64, 62, 62, 75, 62, 63, 75, 64] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2A: widths [67, 62, 62, 75, 62, 62, 75, 62] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [88, 62, 62, 62, 62, 62, 62, 67] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r3A: widths [88, 55, 55, 55, 55, 55, 75, 89] · table 528×293px · row heights [94, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Decide as a designer:
- "preferred": the best design(s). Name more than one only if they are genuinely equally good.
- "acceptable": other designs a careful designer would still publish.
- "bad": designs with clear visual faults, each with the fault. If none of these is clearly bad, also return ONE deliberately bad but plausible alternative as "contrast" widths and say what is wrong with it.
- "ranges": for each column, the px range within which the preferred design stays equally good (keep other columns' proportions).
- "rationale": 2–4 concrete sentences about this table.
- "principles": observations that seem GENERAL (likely to hold for other tables) vs SPECIFIC to this case.
- "tradeoffs" and "uncertain": what reasonable designers could disagree on.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"preferred":["name"],"acceptable":["name"],"bad":[{"design":"name","why":""}],"contrast":{"widths":[int px],"why":""} or null,"ranges":[[min,max]],"rationale":"","principles":{"general":[""],"specific":[""]},"tradeoffs":"","uncertain":""}
